title: Risk factors of breakthrough urinary tract infection in children with primary vesicoureteral reflux
core_idea: Determine which clinical factors predict occurrence of breakthrough urinary tract infections in children with primary vesicoureteral reflux who are on antibiotic prophylaxis, using retrospective record review and statistical analysis.
tldr: A retrospective study of pediatric primary VUR aimed to identify factors associated with breakthrough UTIs despite prophylactic antibiotics by analyzing medical records with univariate and multivariate methods.
